_comment: Fill in each provider with a real endpoint. Your token from setup goes into api_key (__GATEWAY_TOKEN__ is replaced at install). One provider block per model. The `name/model` selector (for example `anthropic/claude-opus-4-6`) is what crew sessions use. This is crew's provider map; CCR 3's live state stays in SQLite and is updated through its authenticated local RPC. Transformer: use `Anthropic` for the Anthropic Messages API, `OpenAI` for OpenAI-compatible chat/completions.
